description: This is a PHP source file defining the EmailMan class, which manages email campaigns within the SuiteCRM system. The class includes functionalities such as creating email queries, sending emails, verifying campaigns, handling email addresses, and tracking email interactions. It also contains methods for creating reference emails, individual emails, and managing opt-in/opt-out processes.

classes.name: EmailMan
classes.description: Represents an email campaign entity in SuiteCRM, encapsulating functionality for managing email campaigns, including sending, verification, query building, and relationship handling.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Constructs a SQL query for listing email campaign entries based on provided filters, order, and parameters.

methods.name: create_queue_items_query
methods.description: Builds a SQL query to retrieve queued email campaign items, supporting filtering, ordering, and grouping.

methods.name: create_list_query
methods.description: Generates a SQL query for listing email campaign records with related data such as recipient name and email.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Retrieves and formats data for the email campaign list view, including recipient info and email links.

methods.name: set_as_sent
methods.description: Marks an email as sent, optionally deleting or updating its record, and logs campaign activity.

methods.name: create_ref_email
methods.description: Creates or loads a reference email record for campaign tracking, and manages related notes and relationships.

methods.name: create_indiv_email
methods.description: Generates a personalized email record for an individual recipient based on a template.

methods.name: verify_campaign
methods.description: Checks if the email marketing and template configurations are correctly set up for a campaign.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Main method to prepare and send campaign emails, handling email validation, tracking, attachments, and success/failure processing.

methods.name: valid_email_address
methods.description: Validates the format of an email address using a regex pattern.

methods.name: is_primary_email_address
methods.description: Checks whether the given bean has a primary email address designated.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds a SQL query for exporting email campaign data.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Deletes an email campaign record from the database.

methods.name: getLastOptInWarn
methods.description: Retrieves and resets the last opt-in warning state.

methods.name: addOptInEmailToEmailQueue
methods.description: Adds an email address to the opt-in email queue if the configuration allows, handling opt-in status.

methods.name: sendOptInEmail
methods.description: Sends an opt-in confirmation email to a user if opt-in process is enabled.

methods.name: sendOptInEmailViaMailer
methods.description: Constructs and dispatches the actual opt-in email using SugarPHPMailer, with tracking tokens.

methods.name: shouldBlockEmail
methods.description: Determines if an email address should be blocked based on opt-out or invalid status.

methods.name: getTargetId
methods.description: Gets the internal target ID used for tracking the email campaign.

methods.name: setTargetId
methods.description: Sets the internal target ID for the email campaign.
